subject: Tri-party demo window arbitration and runbook handoff for Orbit Systems

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orbitsys.com>

Cc: partner-ops@orbitsys.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit > Redwood + Skyline SI — scheduling a co-sell/demo (3 candidate windows)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the intro. Orbit is excited to do a joint demo with Redwood and the Skyline SI (we'll be co-presenting the integration + marketplace listing). To avoid a long back-and-forth, here are three windows from our side (all PT):

- Wed Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Nov 4, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Mon Nov 8, 08:00–09:00 PT (for APAC-friendly overlap)

We expect the audience to include a DM from Orbit (me), two architects from Skyline, and ~6 product folks. Can you: (1) confirm which window works for Redwood, (2) confirm an internal co-host from Redwood who can cover infra and "how inference is served" (low-level questions), and (3) share any runbook or pre-read you want attendees to have?

Attached is a short requirements doc with the expected walkthrough and demo notes.

Appreciate a quick reply — Orbit would prefer to lock one of the first two slots if possible.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Partner Programs — Orbit Systems
Attachments: orbit-demo-requirements.docx (docx, 45KB)

Jordan — thanks for the clear options and the doc.

Quick answers:
- We can cover infra and serving details — I propose Karthik Iyer as the technical co-host (he's looped).
- From Redwood PM/partner ops I will be the coordinator; Vanessa is included for calendar ops and Marketplace listing questions.

Availability notes from our side (PT):
- Wed Nov 3: free 09:30–11:30 (so your 10:00 slot is fine)
- Thu Nov 4: 12:30–14:00 (your 13:00 works but it's tight)
- Mon Nov 8: we only have 07:30–08:30 — that's doable but only if Skyline confirms APAC folks

Can Karthik confirm that the demo run-of-show in your doc matches what he expects (particularly the latency/quantization section)? Karthik — pinged you for a quick sign-off on what we should bring as pre-read/runbook.

If we lock Nov 3 10:00 PT, Vanessa will send the calendar invite + dial-in and I'll attach a runbook draft.

Sofia Ivanova

> Can Karthik confirm that the demo run-of-show in your doc matches what he expects (particularly the latency/quantization section)?

Thanks, Sofia — quick read through the doc looks good. A couple of notes for the run-of-show:
- We'll need a 5–7 minute live segment showing the token-level latency dashboard (Marcus can own the dashboard capture).
- Please ask Orbit to call out expected sequence lengths (are they using multi-turn chat with 1k+ tokens?) — that affects batching and the model variant we bring.
- I'll prepare a 1-page runbook (pre-populated with fallbacks: smaller model variant, region failover to us-east-1).

Nov 3 10:00 PT works for me. If we lock it, I'll upload runbook_v1.pdf to the shared drive and Vanessa can attach to the invite.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
